description: At Jumanji Café, we believe that the best adventures happen when people come together. Our mission is to create unforgettable experiences through the magic of board games, exceptional coffee, and genuine connections.

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just discovering the joy of tabletop adventures, our welcoming space in the heart of Jeddah is designed to bring out the child in everyone. Every game tells a story, and every visit creates memories that last a lifetime.

overview.title: Game Overview
overview.description: In Catan, players try to be the dominant force on the island of Catan by building settlements, cities, and roads. On each turn dice are rolled to determine what resources the island produces. Players collect these resources to build up their civilizations to get to 10 victory points and win the game.

subtitleParts.text: Discover how a passion for games, laughter, and connection led  to the

description: Jumanji Café was born from a simple yet powerful belief: that the magic of board games has the power to bring people together in extraordinary ways. Our founders, passionate gamers and coffee enthusiasts, noticed a gap in Jeddah's entertainment scene - a place where families, friends, and strangers could connect over the timeless joy of tabletop adventures.

What started as weekend game nights among friends evolved into a dream of creating Saudi Arabia's premier board game destination. We wanted to build more than just a café - we envisioned a community hub where laughter echoes through the air, where strategic minds meet creative spirits, and where every visit becomes a memorable adventure.

Since opening our doors in 2020, Jumanji Café has become a beloved gathering place for game enthusiasts of all ages. From seasoned strategists tackling complex campaigns to families discovering their first cooperative adventure, our space welcomes everyone ready to roll the dice on fun.

mission.title: Mission &
mission.description: Guided by our passion for connection and community, we strive to create extraordinary experiences

cards.title: Our Mission
cards.description: To create a welcoming space where people of all ages and backgrounds can discover the joy of board games, forge meaningful connections, and build lasting memories over exceptional coffee and delicious treats. We believe that every game tells a story, every laugh creates a bond, and every visit should leave you feeling more connected to your community and yourself.

cards.title: Our Vision
cards.description:
To become the leading board game community hub in Saudi Arabia, inspiring a new generation of gamers and establishing Jeddah as a destination for tabletop entertainment and social connection.
We envision a future where board game cafés are integral to Saudi communities, fostering creativity, strategic thinking, and social bonds across generations.
